articles.title: Inspired by elephant trunks, these shape-shifting robots bend, grab and team up
articles.description:
Researchers at Colorado State University have developed a flexible robot that functions like an elephant’s trunk to grip objects, with a goal of one day sending teams of these machines to aid in space exploration or to help with any number of other complex tasks. 
The robots are described in detail in Nature Machine Intelligence and are designed to address limitations in current robotic systems, which are more commonly built from rigid blocks that limit the shapes they can form.

articles.title: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Code verified Signal's cryptographic core in four weeks instead of years
articles.description: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Code mathematically verified Signal's cryptographic core code in four weeks, a process that typically takes years. AI agents powered by Gemini Carbon wrote more than six million lines of proof code and flagged only about one percent for human review. Deepmind plans to extend the method to critical infrastructure like power grids and medical devices.
